title: Python service onboarding
summary: How to set up the local Python service.
body: Install Python, create a virtual environment, and run the service smoke tests before opening a pull request.

title: Release checklist
body: Confirm changelog entries, notify support, verify rollout notes, and prepare rollback instructions.

title: Incident review template
summary: Template for writing clear incident reviews.
body: Capture impact, timeline, contributing factors, customer communication, and follow-up actions.

title: Support escalation playbook
summary: How support should escalate urgent customer issues.
body: Triage the issue, collect account context, assign severity, and notify the owning engineering team.
